name: tmi-portal
description: Tutor management portal for the Mathematics Institute of the Triangle

scripts.typecheck: node scripts/check-org-scope.mjs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && node scripts/typecheck-mobile.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy --workspace @tmi/api
scripts.deploy:test: npm run build && npm run deploy:test --workspace @tmi/api
scripts.db:reset:test: npm run db:rebuild:test --workspace @tmi/api && npm run db:seed:test --workspace @tmi/api && npm run db:platform-admin:test --workspace @tmi/api
scripts.mobile:install: npm ci --prefix apps/mobile || npm install --prefix apps/mobile
